This conference took place between the 18th and 20th of December 2025 at the National Technical University of Athens' School of Applied Mathematics and Physical Sciences. I presented joint work with my advisor, Sourav Sarkar regarding the geometry of the KPZ fixed point.

The 49th Research Students' Conference in Probability and Statistics was held in Cambridge (UK) from 31 August to 4 September 2026. The conference brings together PhD and predoctoral researchers in probability, statistics and related fields from across the UK and Europe.

I was part of the organising committee and was responsible for the Probability section of the conference.

I gave a talk on recent work with my advisor, Sourav Sarkar on the Brownian regularity of the KPZ fixed point.
